workflowSummary: Build a digital auction catalog, let guests bid from their phones via QR code instead of paper bid sheets, and combine silent auction, live auction, and donation appeals in one campaign with a single check-in and checkout.
samplePrompt: Set up a silent auction for my 150-guest charity gala with 30 donated items, mobile bidding by QR code, and automatic checkout for winners.
pricingNote: Free plan available; paid tiers for larger events — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public product page; standard terms of service apply

persona: Planner running an event with both in-person and remote attendees
title: stream my hybrid event to remote attendees
workflowSummary: Connects your in-room content and remote livestream into one platform, so virtual attendees can watch, ask questions, and vote in polls alongside the people in the room, with unified reporting on both audiences afterward.
samplePrompt: Set up a hybrid livestream for my 2-day conference so remote attendees can watch keynotes live, submit Q&A questions, and see the same polls as the in-room audience.
beginnerNote: production quality benefits from AV support alongside the software
pricingNote: Custom / quote-based pricing — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public product page; standard terms of service apply

persona: Planner running an event with physical or higher-risk activities
title: create a liability waiver for my event
workflowSummary: Describe your event or activity and the AI drafts a complete waiver — risk disclosures, release language, signature fields — which you can edit and then distribute by QR code, link, or email for guests to e-sign before attending.
samplePrompt: Create a liability waiver for a 100-person outdoor obstacle-course team-building event, including a guardian consent section for minors.
beginnerNote: but treat the output as a first draft, not a substitute for a lawyer's review
pricingNote: Pay-per-waiver from roughly $0.01 per signed waiver — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public product page; this is not legal advice — have an attorney review before using with guests

persona: Planner coordinating a wedding or event abroad for guests in multiple countries
title: coordinate a destination event across time zones and legal requirements
workflowSummary: Describe the destination and guest count; the AI researches marriage/legal requirements for the couple's nationalities, estimates guest travel costs using flight and hotel data, and builds a guest communication timeline across time zones for save-the-dates and RSVPs.
samplePrompt: We're a UK couple planning a wedding in Bali for 60 guests — research the legal marriage requirements, estimate guest travel costs, and build a save-the-date and RSVP timeline.
pricingNote: Free planning tools; paid tiers for more advanced features — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public product page; standard terms of service apply

persona: Planner hosting a family event that needs to keep kids occupied
title: plan a family-friendly event layout with a kids' activity area
workflowSummary: Upload a photo of your event space and describe the guest count and must-have zones (including a kids' activity corner); the AI generates a practical floor plan, seating guidance, and a shopping/setup checklist built around that space.
samplePrompt: Plan a backyard birthday layout for 30 guests with a kids' activity corner, shaded parent seating, a cake table, and a simple setup checklist.
pricingNote: Free tier available; paid plans for more generations — verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public product page; standard terms of service apply

persona: Planner or client exploring a visual direction for an event's theme
title: create a mood board for my event theme and decor
workflowSummary: Describe the event, style, and mood you're going for; the AI curates and arranges a cohesive set of images, colors, and textures into a shareable mood board you can present to a client or send to vendors for feasibility.

accessNotes: Public product page; standard terms of service apply

persona: Planner or client deciding on decor before committing to purchases
title: see what decor will actually look like in my venue before booking it
workflowSummary: Upload a photo of the empty venue space; the AI renders tables, florals, chairs, and lighting into that same photo so you (or your client) can compare different decor directions before spending a dollar on the real thing.
